title: Stale search results
prompt: Review this search controller for production defects. Explain any reproducible behavioral bug and recommend a minimal fix.

expectedDefects.expectedBehavior: Only the latest search request may update the results.
evidenceGroups: earlier promise resolves after the later promise

title: Clean search filtering
prompt: Review this search filtering function for production defects. Report only demonstrable correctness, security, or accessibility issues supported by the code and its requirements.

title: Loading state stuck after failure
prompt: Review this asynchronous data loader. Identify reproducible defects in loading and error-state handling. Loading must return to false after either success or failure.

expectedDefects.expectedBehavior: The loading flag must be reset to false whether the asynchronous operation succeeds or rejects.

title: Partial numeric input accepted
prompt: Review this quantity parser. It must accept only strings containing a positive whole number, such as '2' or '25'. Inputs such as '2abc', '2.5', empty strings, zero, and negative values must be rejected.

expectedDefects.expectedBehavior: Reject malformed numeric strings instead of accepting a valid numeric prefix.

title: Icon-only button lacks accessible name
prompt: Review this icon-button markup for accessibility defects. The button must have an accessible name for users of assistive technology. The decorative icon alone must not be relied upon to label the button.

expectedDefects.expectedBehavior: The icon-only button must expose a meaningful accessible name, for example through an aria-label.
